heroDescription: Turn your ideas into images, stories, music and more. One creative space, every possibility.
chooseDescription: Find the right studio for your next big idea.
emptyDescription: Save a draft, upload your media, or create with a connected AI model.
freeNote: Basic images never use credits. Capacity limits apply.
imageDesc: Bring a vision to life, one prompt at a time.
musicDesc: Find your sound. Write your next chorus.
videoDesc: Make your stories move, scene by scene.
minidramaDesc: Build a world of characters and stories.
voiceDesc: Give your words a voice of their own.
textDesc: From the first idea to the final word.
name: Name
loginDescription: Your ideas, safely saved and always yours.
title: Project title
promptHint: Be specific. Describe the mood, details, language and style you want.
unavailable: AI generation is waiting for provider configuration. You can still save drafts and upload your own media.
adapterPending: Video generation and automatic episode assembly are still in development. Save your script here.
uploadHint: PNG, JPG, WebP, MP3, WAV, OGG, MP4 or TXT · up to 30 MB
plansNotice: Payments are not activated. No subscriptions or credit purchases are available yet.
freePlanDescription: Drafts, private library, uploads and downloads are available. Basic AI images cost zero credits when the provider is enabled.
deleteWarning: This permanently deletes your account, jobs and media. Enter your password to confirm.
helpTitle: A little help for your next creation
answer1: An administrator must connect a server-side API key, verify model access and activate the studio. Your drafts and media library work independently.
answer2: Basic images use zero user credits. The operator pays infrastructure costs and applies capacity limits.
answer3: Files stay in private storage. Download links expire after five minutes. You can rename, export or delete your work.
faq4: Can I create a three-minute video?
answer4: The video worker can assemble clips into an 8–180 second file. It requires an enabled video model; live provider generation and visual continuity still need validation.
answer5: Compatible JavaScript changes can use Expo OTA. Native changes require a new app build. Mobile store releases are not available yet.
error: The operation failed. Please try again.
providerError: The AI provider is not configured or is unavailable.
limitError: Capacity limit reached. Please try again later.
creditsError: You do not have enough available credits.
billingAck: I verified capabilities, terms, pricing and accept provider billing.
accountNeeded: Sign in to save your work.
scriptOnly: Edit scripts, characters and scenes below. Automatic lip-sync and continuity scoring are not implemented.
musicNote: Music generation uses a dedicated music model, not text-to-speech. Exact lyric verification is not available yet.
voiceNote: Use only text and voices you have permission to use. No voice cloning is offered.
referenceNote: Reference images are sent to the selected image model only.
privacy: Your workspace is private. AI prompts are sent to the configured provider when you generate.
resetSent: If this account exists, a reset link has been sent.
storyboardNote: Edit characters and scenes, assign reference images or your own video clips, then assemble an episode. Generated speech and lip-sync require human review.
saveBeforeRender: Save changes before generating or assembling. Reload the project after generation to attach the finished scene. Keep dialogue under review; automatic lip-sync verification is not implemented.
providerBillingNotice: Your prompt is sent to the provider. Audio/video requests can be stored there for operation recovery; review its terms. Free user credits do not mean a free provider API.
providerQuota: The provider quota is exhausted. Check the project quota or try later.
providerAccess: This model is not accessible with the configured account or region.
episodeReviewNote: A real episode uses character reference images and generated scene clips, then assembles the final video. Review dialogue, lip-sync and continuity; automated visual guarantees are not provided.
servicePausedBody: AI creation is currently unavailable. You can still organize projects, upload files, preview, listen and download.
accountRetentionNotice: Keep a copy of your account data and project information. They may be lost when the service restarts.
modelPricingNotice: Provider pricing varies by model. Haytile credits are separate from API charges.
miniModelChoiceNote: For MiniDrama, this selects the planning and script model. Images and clips use the configured studio models.
adminPersistence: Credit and plan changes are locked: account balances still use temporary Render storage. A durable account database is required.
manualPlanNote: Manual plan access with an expiry date. No automatic payment, renewal or monthly credits. Only the credits entered here are granted once; AI provider billing remains separate.
activationHelp: Owner only: enter the private activation code configured on the server. An email address alone cannot activate admin access.
durableAccountsNotice: Accounts, sessions, balances, jobs, projects and library metadata are saved in Firebase. Keep your own backup of important creations.
walletReady: Balances, plans and credit transactions are saved in Firebase. Credits are reserved before paid generation and debited once on completion. Haytile credits do not recharge Google API.
creditBillingPending: Credit-based billing for this model is not available yet. No Haytile credits were charged.
stageUpdatesNote: Progress reflects actual job stages. The file becomes playable when generation and checks finish.
resultUnavailable: Result currently unavailable in your library
generationFailed: Generation failed. Review the error in job history before retrying.
resultsWillAppear: Your results will appear here when they are ready.
autoTitleHint: A title is suggested automatically. You can edit it.
quoteUnavailable: The price could not be confirmed. No generation has been started.
reservationNotice: Credits are reserved on confirmation, debited once when the file is ready, and released if the job fails.
chatIntroduction: I’m your AI assistant. I can help you write, learn, develop ideas, lyrics and scripts. Tell me what you would like to create.
chatIdeaStory: Help me develop an original story
chatIdeaLyrics: Help me write a song in Haitian Creole
chatIdeaExplain: Explain something to me step by step
chatThinking: HAYTILE AI is preparing a reply…
chatFailed: The reply could not be generated.
chatSyncError: Connection interrupted. Your saved conversation is preserved.
chatEnterHint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line
chatDisclaimer: HAYTILE AI can make mistakes. Check important information. Free text uses provider capacity limits.
